decisions.reason: The Power Board dimensions, connector placement, and mounting details do not change the active three-board architecture.
The mechanical form-factor decision does not alter battery protection, cutoff, or thermal-protection behavior.
The source specifies USB-C placement and mounting geometry but does not change the battery connector or its NTC contact.
Locating USB-C on the shorter edge does not change the requirement for TVS ESD protection.
The Power Board's mechanical layout does not alter I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The board shape and mounting constraints do not change ESP32 clock, sleep, or wake behavior.
The mechanical form-factor decision does not change the switched 5V rail's control, default state, or sensor-power behavior.
